end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Eid, and Christmas traditions across India.
Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
Kavya first said festival dates were random, then corrected this to harvest time.
Identified Makar Sankranti as a January festival in winter; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised festival traditions and used questions about farming, seeds, rain, and cutting crops to connect harvest festivals with the right season. Kavya mixed up harvest festivals with random dates at first, then corrected the idea by saying they happen when crops are ready to cut. At home, ask Kavya to name one harvest festival and explain what happens to crops before it is celebrated.
